spans.s: ष्फ feminine affix अायनी, termed also तद्वित (l) added, according to the Eastern school of grammarians, to words ending with the tad. affix यञ् ( prescribed by rules like गर्गादिभ्यो यञ्

) e. g. गार्ग्यायणी, वात्स्यायनी as contrasted with गांर्गी or वात्सी according to the Western school of Paini; (2) added to form feminine bases of the words from लोहित to कत to which यञ् has already been added as also to the words कौरव्य and माण्डूक. e. g. लौहित्यायनी, बाभ्रव्यायणी, कात्यायनी, कौरव्या- यणी, माण्डूकायनी cf.
स्फ a short technical term used in the jainendra Vyakarana instead of the संयेाग in Panini's grammar.

ष्फक् tad. affix आयन, added to the words कापिशी and रङ्कु as also to the words बाह्री, उर्दि in the residual or miscellaneous tad. senses; e. g. कापिशायनं मधु, कापिशायनी द्राक्षा, राङ्कवायणो गौ;, बाहृायनी, और्दायनी, पार्दायनी, cf. M. Bh. on
